research.title: A Multidimensional Evaluation Framework for Artificial Intelligence-Based Ocean State Forecasts
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) based ocean state forecasts now approach or surpass those produced by operational ocean forecasting systems as measured by conventional pointwise metrics. However, these metrics may favor spatially smoothed forecasts and cannot determine whether. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: From Sea Surface Height to Velocity - A Machine Learning Approach
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Inferring upper-ocean velocity from altimetric sea surface height (SSH) remains challenging below 50~km, scales now resolved by the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) mission. Conventional methods rely on geostrophic or cyclogeostrophic balance. Here, we demonstrate. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Machine learning emulators of dynamic global vegetation models for fast gridded carbon budget predictions
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The land carbon sink explains most of the variability of the atmospheric CO2 growth rate, but the Global Carbon Budget estimates it with dynamic global vegetation models (DGVMs) run once a year. Emulators could provide it. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: RadarFill: Observation-Constrained Gap Filling of Systematic Blind Zones in 3-D Weather Radar Reflectivity Mosaics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Ground-based weather radar mosaics contain systematic blind zones, especially at low altitudes, where missing reflectivity lacks corresponding complete observations for direct verification. We present RadarFill, an observation-constrained conditional diffusion framework for gap filling in three-dimensional radar. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Milky Way grew by devouring galaxies, leaving a trail of ghost stars
research.summary: Galactic archaeologists are using precise measures and larger sample sizes afforded by new missions to tease apart minute differences between groups of stars, revealing the history of the Milky Way going back almost 12 billion years

research.title: The Nonlinear Physics and Statistical Field Theory of Twilight Clouds: Hovering Dynamics and Dynamic Inertia Emergence
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Twilight clouds are small, optically faint warm clouds whose droplets fluctuate between haze and activated growth. We develop a nonequilibrium statistical field theory linking this regime to cloud-field organization through K\"ohler microphysics, supersaturation transport, and turbulent. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Tropical Cyclone-Following Dataset for Limited-Area Machine Learning Applications
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a lightweight dataset of tropical cyclone (TC)-following meteorological variables to facilitate the development and application of machine learning (ML) methods in TC research. Using outputs from our previous climate downscaling and idealized simulations. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: What is the debate on NavIC vs GPS | Explained
research.summary: From a strategic perspective, the argument is quite straightforward given the origins of the IRNSS concept in the aftermath of the U.S.’s denial of its Global Positioning Service (GPS) during the 1999 Kargil conflict
